moves.watch: stays quiet and aims its instruments at the source
moves.hide: goes quieter: cuts its hum, dims its works
moves.guard: builds pickets and depots toward the source
moves.knock: knocks back: a short aimed signal, its name optional
moves.answer: replies with message parts: findings, records, questions, offers
moves.probe: sends a probe or a watcher
moves.warn: tells a third party, openly or covertly
moves.mask: sends forged parts: a false face, or bait
moves.catch: catches or disables a probe in its system
moves.strike: plans a strike, fired when its weapons are ready
